title: 2010 AMC 12B 11
statement: A palindrome between \(1000\) and \(10{,}000\) is chosen at random. What is the probability that it is divisible by \(7?\)

solutions.text:
A four-digit palindrome has the form \(\overline{abba}=1001a+110b\) with \(1\le a\le9\) and \(0\le b\le9.\)

Since \(1001=7\cdot11\cdot13\) is divisible by \(7\) and \(110\) is not, the number is divisible by \(7\) exactly when \(b\) is divisible by \(7,\) that is \(b=0\) or \(b=7.\)

For each \(a,\) that is \(2\) of the \(10\) choices of \(b,\) a probability of \(\dfrac{2}{10}=\dfrac15.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: \(1001=7\cdot11\cdot13\) is divisible by \(7,\) but \(110\) is not
